title: Their Ingratitude Does Not Diminish You
description:
You poured your life into them. You gave everything you had. But a quiet ache remains, a feeling of being unseen, unappreciated, or even worse, demanded from. This isn't a feeling you talk about easily, but it sits heavy.

This video offers a stoic perspective on navigating the deep pain of an ungrateful adult child. Drawing on stoic wisdom from figures like Seneca, Marcus Aurelius, and Epictetus, we explore how to find peace when your efforts are not recognized. It's about reclaiming your inner calm, understanding what truly lies within your control, and building a legacy of purpose after 50 that depends on your own virtue, not external validation. This wisdom is for men over 50 asking deeper questions about midlife and what remains.
